dataset: Global Carbon Budget 2025 v1.0 / fossil CO2 by fuel
paper: Friedlingstein et al., Global Carbon Budget 2025, Earth System Science Data, 2026
target_boundary: Only coal_mt + oil_mt + gas_mt is used as observed direct-combustion target. Cement, flaring, and other remain explicit but excluded.

transport.note: Transport copy used to materialize the compact audit snapshot; values are checked against the GCB 2025 fuel-category definition and coverage described by the official paper.

vintage_limitation: This is a current GCB 2025 vintage snapshot. It is not an archived release-as-of-origin series for the 2010-2024 validation origins.

primary_source.dataset: The Global Carbon Project's fossil CO2 emissions dataset
